timeline.summary: Deputy MD Vikram Saha stepped down effective April 15, 2026, due to transfer by parent bank.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,073.65 Cr, net profit ₹345.67 Cr (+47.8% YoY).
Can Fin Homes reported FY26 PAT of ₹1,086 Cr (+27% YoY) on a loan book of ₹42,209 Cr.
Can Fin Homes Limited shared the audio recording of its April 27, 2026, earnings call on its website.
On April 27, 2026, Can Fin Homes held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 14% AUM growth in FY27 and noting 85% of loans moved to quarterly reset.
Shri Suresh S Iyer (MD & CEO) and Shri Abhishek Mishra (CFO) participated in Investec’s Analyst/Investor Meet on May 06, 2026, discussing Q4 FY25-26 results, growth, and business prospects.
Canara Bank, as promoter, disclosed 29.99% stake in Can Fin Homes Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations on 2026-04-01.
Canara Bank, as Can Fin Homes Limited’s promoter, disclosed no encumbrance by itself or its PAC during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s takeover rules (7 April 2026).

On 2026-06-08 Can Fin Homes' board approved raising up to ₹5,000 Cr via debt instruments subject to AGM approval, fixed July 03, 2026 as record date for a ₹8 final dividend, named Smt. Varsha Vasant Purandare an independent director from July 30, 2026, and allotted 466 ESOP shares at ₹842.80.

On 20 July 2026, Can Fin Homes' Q1FY27 call reported disbursements of ₹2,609 Cr against a ₹2,500 Cr plan, NIM of 3.81% and AUM growth of 10.8%, with FY27 guidance of ₹13,000 Cr disbursements and 14% AUM growth retained.
On October 13, 2026, Can Fin Homes reported that Care Ratings reaffirmed its CARE AAA rating on ₹27,240 Cr debt instruments and CARE A1+ on ₹4,500 Cr commercial paper.
Can Fin Homes released its investor presentation for Q2 FY27 reporting a loan book of ₹43,539 Cr and PAT of ₹275 Cr.
On 17 October 2026, Can Fin Homes reported Q2FY27 PAT of ₹275 Cr on revenue of ₹1,131 Cr, noting branch disbursements of ₹2,375 Cr following the complete rollout of Project Tejas.
